name: Every Fixed Auxiliary Level Has Conditioning Closure MaxMin
statement: For every fixed integer $k\geq0$, $\operatorname{Cl}_c(\mathsf M_k)=\mathsf{MaxMin}$ under the displayed-coordinate convention.
proof: Conditioning $j$ visible coordinates sends $\mathsf M_k$ into $\mathsf M_{k+j}\subseteq\mathsf{MaxMin}$. Conversely, $\mathsf M_0=\mathsf{Max}\subseteq\mathsf M_k$, and every MaxMin class is a conditioning of a maximum class.
